title: NatWest Names Triona O’Keeffe Chief Data and Analytics Officer
summary:
The LSEG data chief joins NatWest in January 2027 to lead a merged data, AI and engineering function under Group CIO Scott Marcar.
The post NatWest Names Triona O’Keeffe Chief Data and Analytics Officer appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: NatWest has appointed Triona O'Keeffe as its new Chief Data and Analytics Officer. Currently serving as LSEG's data chief, O'Keeffe will assume the role in January 2027. She will oversee a newly merged function covering data, artificial intelligence, and engineering, operating under the leadership of Group Chief Information Officer Scott Marcar.

content: Corporate treasury operations are experiencing a significant shift with the introduction of agentic artificial intelligence.
